description: Known limitations of packages in webR. Advisory only: check_inventory() shows these as notes and never marks a package unavailable because of them.

packages.name: rJava
packages.reason: Requires a Java runtime, which is not available in WebAssembly

packages.name: RCurl
packages.reason: Some HTTP functions may not work due to browser restrictions

packages.name: odbc
packages.reason: Requires ODBC drivers, which are not available in WebAssembly

packages.name: RSQLite
packages.reason: Works, but databases do not persist across sessions

packages.name: reticulate
packages.reason: Python integration is not available in WebAssembly

packages.name: parallel
packages.reason: Parallel processing has limited functionality in WebAssembly

packages.name: future
packages.reason: Asynchronous execution may behave differently in the browser

packages.name: processx
packages.reason: Installs, but cannot start external processes in the browser

packages.name: sys
packages.reason: Installs, but cannot run system commands in the browser

packages.name: V8
packages.reason: Installs; runs JavaScript through webR's worker rather than the V8 engine

packages.name: openssl
packages.reason: Cryptographic functions may behave differently in the browser
